description: Takes no arguments and returns this month's usage of the business's Neuron plan: plan, reason, and lines. Each line has key (what is counted), included (the plan's allowance), used (null when Neuron cannot measure it — never read null as zero), source (where the number came from or why it is missing), and measuredAt. lines is empty when the business has no paid plan. This Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only and reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:usage on the consent screen. Results are JSON objects also returned as text; the limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.
name: neuron_usage

lines.description: One line per metered allowance of the plan.

title: Get plan usage
